title: RNA Isolation from Plant Tissue Using CTAB-PVP-TRIzol Method
author: Unknown
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.4q5gvy6
materials: Grind tissue to a powder in liquid nitrogen.
Then add 300 µL TRIzol reagent and equal volume of chloroform to TRIzol reagent (Invitrogen).

steps.title: Initial Tissue Extraction
steps.instruction: Extract RNA from ground plant tissue using pre-heated extraction buffer.

substeps.instruction: Add 200 mg – 500 mg of ground tissue to 3.0 mL of pre-heated extraction buffer in a 5 ml tube.
Vortex the tube until the tissue is mixed with the buffer.
Incubate the tube at 65 °C for 00:30:00, vortexing briefly (00:00:15) every 2–3 min during the incubation.

steps.title: Clarification of Extract
steps.instruction: Separate insoluble matter from the mixture via centrifugation.

substeps.instruction: Aliquot the mixture into four 2 ml RNase free tubes, 1 mL in each tube.
Spin the tubes in a centrifuge for 00:10:00.
Pour the supernatant into a new 2 ml tube.

steps.title: Phase Separation
steps.instruction: Perform chloroform:isoamyl alcohol extraction to separate phases.

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of 24:1 chloroform:isoamyl alcohol to fill the tube.
Vortex tubes until the phases mix and appear cloudy.
Spin the tubes in a centrifuge for 00:10:00.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to new 2 ml RNase free tubes.

steps.title: First RNA Precipitation and Wash
steps.instruction: Precipitate and wash the RNA pellet.

substeps.instruction: Spin tubes in a centrifuge for 00:20:00 and decant the supernatant, taking care not to lose the pellet.
Add 1 mL 75 % cooled ethanol to the pellet.
Spin the tube at maximum speed for 00:05:00 in a centrifuge.
Open cap and air-dry the pellet.

steps.title: Pellet Dissolution and Purification
steps.instruction: Dissolve the pellet and perform further centrifugation steps.

substeps.instruction: Add 30 µL RNase free water to dissolve the pellet.
Centrifuge for 00:10:00.
Transfer the upper aqueous phase to a new 2 ml RNase free tube.
Spin tubes at 4 °C for 00:20:00 in a centrifuge.
Decant the supernatant taking care not to lose the pellet.
Centrifuge at 4 °C for 00:05:00.
Repeat the centrifugation and decanting steps (steps 21 and 22 in original text) one more time.

steps.title: Final Pellet Drying and Dissolution
steps.instruction: Dry and dissolve the purified pellet.

substeps.instruction: Open cap and air dry the pellet.
Add 10 µL – 30 µL RNase free water to dissolve the pellet.
Decant the supernatant carefully.
Repeat the dissolution and decanting steps (steps 14 and 15 in original text) one more time.

steps.title: Incubation and Phase Repeat
steps.instruction: Incubate the sample and repeat phase separation if necessary.

substeps.instruction: Incubate at 20 °C for 00:05:00.
Repeat the phase separation process (steps 8 to 10 in original text) one more time.
Add 1/3 volume of 10 Molarity (M) LiCl to each tube.
Mix and let stand at 4 °C for 06:00:00 – 08:00:00 or overnight to precipitate RNA.
Vortex vigorously and store at 20 °C for 00:05:00.

steps.title: Final Ethanol Precipitation
steps.instruction: Perform final precipitation using ethanol, sodium acetate, and glycogen.

substeps.instruction: Add 2 volumes of cooled 100% ethanol, 1/10 volume of NaAc, and 2 µL of glycogen.
Mix and incubate at -20 °C for 02:00:00.

steps.title: Final Wash and Collection
steps.instruction: Wash the final pellet and remove residual liquid.

substeps.instruction: Add 1 mL 75 % ethanol to the pellet.
Let tube stand at 20 °C for 00:03:00.
Decant the liquid carefully, taking care not to lose the pellet.
Briefly centrifuge to collect the residual liquid and remove it with a pipette.
